name: How do fees work for personal injury cases?

mainEntity.name: How do fees work for personal injury cases?

acceptedAnswer.text: Personal injury cases are handled on a contingency fee basis, meaning you pay nothing unless there is a successful settlement or verdict in your favor.angeloreyeslaw​
